# ex: binary expression needing paren in unary context
ex {
	var x int
	var y int
	x + y -> x - y
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F() int {
	return -(3 + 4)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 package m

 func F() int {
-	return -(3 + 4)
+	return -(3 - 4)
 }
